about_the_game:
The following content is included:

●Quest Completion Animation: Handler Set

The Quest Completion Animation can now feature the Handler! This item includes a set of multiple Quest Completion Animations where the Handler makes an appearance.

Enhance your Quest Completion Animations with special animations and enjoy your hunting life even more!

*You can configure the Additional Quest Completion Animations from the “Quest Completion Animations” found in the “Quest Menu” within “Tent”. Certain quest types, equipment, cutscenes, and other conditions may prevent prioritized animations from being played.
*This product is also available as part of a set.
*You may need to update to the latest version of the game to use this content.
